meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作一个可交互的幻灯片演示文稿，包含独立的幻灯片、逐步显示的内容片段、分支导航、热点区域和演讲者备注。输出的是一个可直接浏览的网页，而不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演示文稿或交互式演示时触发。如果只是提到“演示”或“转换这个页面”，Claude 会先确认你是否需要 HyperFrames 幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于我们产品的幻灯片，5页。
say.note: Claude 会创建幻灯片并询问是否继续。

say.text: 把这个网页转换成幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会先确认，然后保留原设计进行转换。

say.text: 在第三页加一个热点，点击后跳转到详细页。
say.note: Claude 会在幻灯片中添加交互热点。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create an interactive slideshow with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and speaker notes. The output is a navigable web deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, or interactive deck. For vague requests like 'presentation' or 'convert this page', Claude confirms before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a 5-slide deck about our product.
say_en.note: Claude will build the slideshow and ask for confirmation.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into a slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude confirms first, then preserves the original design.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that links to a detail page.
say_en.note: Claude adds an interactive hotspot to the slide.
